meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Azure CLI 的 az quota 查询订阅在各区域的配额上限、当前用量与剩余可用量，并能提交配额提升请求或对比不同区域的容量。
howto.when: 当你提到「check quotas」「service limits」「quota exceeded」等关键词，或要为部署做容量校验时触发。

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 的 vCPU 配额，看哪个区域更充足
say.note: 按区域逐个查询并算出可用量

say.text: standardDSv3Family 配额不够了，帮我提交升到 500 的请求

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses Azure CLI (az quota) to check a subscription's quota limits, current usage and remaining capacity per region, and can submit quota increase requests or compare regions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "check quotas", "service limits", "quota exceeded" and similar terms, or need to validate capacity before a deployment.

say_en.text: Check quota and remaining capacity for Microsoft.Compute in eastus
say_en.note: Returns a table of limits, usage and available

say_en.text: Compare vCPU quota across eastus and westus2 to pick a region
say_en.note: Queries each region and computes availability

say_en.text: My standardDSv3Family quota is too low, request an increase to 500
say_en.note: Check status with az quota request status
